page.overview:
What is Elantris (city)?

Elantris is a fantasy series written by American fantasy and science fiction writer Brandon Sanderson. It takesthumbplace in Sanderson's Cosmere Universe, along with the Mistborn series and The Stormlight Archive series.

This is an article about the Elantris series. For the the Elantris book click here.

Elantris was a radiant city teeming with the most benovolent of people, but that all changed when the Shaod struck. The Disease quickly spread through out the whole city turning the magical demigods into powerless and fragile beings, Elantris itself decaying and falling apart, to be a place of filth and distruction.

Sarene comes to her new city of Kae, Capital of Arelon, crouching beneath the great city of Elantris, just to find her soon-to-be husband had been announced dead. Now considered a widow the new princess of Arelon struggles to take apart the tyranny that has emerged in the dustruction of Elantris.
